test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sequence is correct with respect to the Delhi Dynasties?

options.text: Khalji dynasty, Lodi dynasty, Sayyid dynasty
Tughluq dynasty, Khalji dynasty, Sayyid dynasty
Early Turkish Rulers, Rajput dynasties, Khalji dynasty
Rajput dynasties, Khalji dynasty, Tughluq dynasty

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajput dynasties, Khalji dynasty, Tughluq dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Delhi Sultanate was an Islamic empire based in Delhi that stretched over 320 years.
 
• The ruling dynasties of Delhi included:
 
 
• Rajput dynasties
 
• Early Turkish rulers (1206-1290)
 
• Khalji dynasty (1290-1320)
 
• Tughlaq dynasty (1320-1414)
 
• Sayyid dynasty (1414-1451)
 
• Lodi dynasty (1451-1526)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rajput Dynasties

 
 
• ​Tomaras Early 12th C-1165
 
• Ananga Pala 1130-1145
 
• Chauhans 1165-1192
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan 1175-1192
 
 
 
• Khalji Dynasty:
 
 
• Founder: Jalal-ud-din Firoz Khilji
 
• The Khilji dynasty started from 1290 to 1320 AD.
 
• Famous ruler: Ala-ud-din Khilji
 
• Last ruler: Quṭb al-Din Mubarak Shah.
 
 
 
• **Tughluq Dynasty (1320 to 1413):**
 
 
• **Ghiyas-ud-din Tughluq or Ghazi Malik was the founder of the Tughluq dynasty.**
 
• Ghiyas-ud-din reinstated order in his empire.
 
• He brought Bengal, Utkala or Orissa, and Warangal under his control
 
• The Mongol leaders who invaded North India were seized and confined by him.
 
• **In 1325 A.D. Ghiyas-ud-din** was crushed to death while attending an event for his victories in Bengal.
 
• Junakhan, the crown prince succeeded him.
